_note: What chests and breakable pieces of Weltbauer rooms may hold (src/world_kit/room_contents.gd). chest_mobs: monsters that never stand as monsters when placed, they wait as a chest. mimic_chance: share of chests set to Mimik 'Zufällig' that bite (0 to 1). max_enemies: enemies one chest or piece lets out. random_chest: gold of a chest with content 'Zufällig' is gems_base + gems_per_floor * floor, heart_chance its share with a heart; items come from the game's chest drops (items.json drops.chest). random_piece: chances (sum 1) of a broken piece with content 'Zufällig': nothing, gold_amount gold or a heart; items come from items.json drops.crate. hoard: the Schatz chest of a solved puzzle (content type hoard, loot.tier 1 to 5 by how hard the puzzle is, default_tier when unset); what it pays comes from the Beuteordnung (assets/data/reward_rules.json tiers, docs/BEUTEORDNUNG.de.md) when it is opened, tiers only names the tiers there are. secret_rooms: the Schatz tier of the chest (loot auto) in a floor's secret room behind a secret wall (secret) or a plate riddle (hidden); such a chest is never a Mimik. tablet: the Inschrift stone (Weltbauer part tablet): asset = its picture, foot = px it blocks (width, height), reach = px from the hero within which its text shows.
